name: TestMu AI MCP Server
description: Runs, debugs and triages tests on the TestMu AI cloud from any MCP client: HyperExecute jobs, automation failures, SmartUI visual diffs, accessibility checks and Test Manager.

skills.name: HyperExecute Orchestration
skills.description: Generates HyperExecute YAML and test runner commands, triggers jobs and reports their status, with no manual YAML authoring.

skills.name: Automation Failure Triage
skills.description: Pulls execution details, command, network and console logs for failed automation tests into one place for root-cause analysis.

skills.name: Native App Triage
skills.description: Triages and debugs native mobile app automation tests on real and virtual devices, pulling the failure details for a test's TestID.

skills.name: SmartUI Visual Diffs
skills.description: Explains visual regressions from any SmartUI comparison run as natural-language summaries of pixel, layout, DOM and perceptual differences.

skills.name: Accessibility Checks
skills.description: Runs accessibility checks on hosted URLs or local React apps and returns the violations with remediation guidance.

skills.name: Test Manager Lifecycle
skills.description: Generates test cases with AI, builds configured test runs, records results in bulk, and tracks milestones and coverage.
